laws.title: Pages never implement business logic
laws.summary: Ten domain engines own all business rules, calculations, and state transitions. UI screens and LLM chat interfaces only render outputs and call engines.
laws.violation_penalty: Revert code. Zero inline calculations allowed.

laws.title: Single Query Rule
laws.summary: One canonical booking query serves every surface (quote, pack, dispatch, invoice, return, review). Different screens cannot run divergent queries on the same booking.

laws.title: Nothing is deleted
laws.summary: Hard deletes are banned. Every entity has a named terminal state: Cancel, Void, Reverse, Retire, Archive, Deactivate, or Close.
laws.enforcement: Database Grants (REVOKE DELETE on priced lines, bookings, invoices, payments, audit_events) and Triggers

laws.title: Payments are immutable
laws.summary: A recorded payment cannot be updated or deleted. Corrections are ledger reversal rows referencing the original payment ID.

laws.title: Deposits are liabilities
laws.summary: Security deposits are held in trust as liabilities. They never enter Rental Total, never reduce Outstanding balance, and never count as rental payments.
laws.enforcement: Schema Check Constraints & Financial Engine arithmetic

laws.title: Warehouse sees no money
laws.summary: Staff in warehouse and logistics roles cannot view rates, line totals, deposits, or invoice balances. Enforced at database level via Row Level Security and masking views (_v).

laws.title: Store AD in UTC
laws.summary: All database timestamps and business date calculations are stored in UTC Anno Domini (AD). Bikram Sambat (BS) is rendered exclusively for client display, never stored.

laws.title: Every write carries a client UUID
laws.summary: Every mutation submitted by UI, mobile, or offline queue must include a client-generated UUID for replay-safe idempotency. Duplicate submissions are safely discarded.

laws.title: Days mandatory on every priced line
laws.summary: Duration in days must be explicitly specified (minimum 1) on every priced rental line. Days cannot be omitted or defaulted to null.

laws.title: Discount approval & 25% hard cap
laws.summary: Discounts <= 10% are standard. Discounts > 10% require a reason >= 10 characters and a named authorizing approver (Manager or Owner). Hard cap is 25% across all stacked discounts with zero role bypass, including Owner.

laws.title: Never colour alone
laws.summary: Status and alerts must always render Icon + Label + Colour. Colour alone is never the sole carrier of meaning, ensuring accessibility and visibility on monochrome/greyscale screens.

laws.title: Errors inline and persistent
laws.summary: Validation and submission errors must be rendered inline next to the failing input and persist until resolved. Toast notifications are strictly reserved for success confirmations.

laws.title: No platform branch in layout components
laws.summary: Layout components branch on screen width or capability (e.g., touch target, pointer capability), never on operating system or device user-agent strings.

laws.title: Width decides (768 / 1180)
laws.summary: Responsive layouts adapt strictly by viewport width breakpoints (< 768 phone, 768-1180 tablet, >= 1180 desktop). Never branch on orientation alone.

laws.title: 44x44 touch targets
laws.summary: All interactive elements, buttons, chips, and toggles must meet the 44x44 pixel minimum touch target size across all devices, including desktop monitors.

laws.title: Validated computation before AI display
laws.summary: No AI assistant panel or automated recommendation may render figures or kit configurations until validated by an underlying domain computation engine.

laws.title: Strict vocabulary: Clients, never Customers
laws.summary: The word 'customer' is strictly banned from all UI screens, notifications, invoices, and system code. They are always referred to as 'Clients'.

stages.name: Booked
stages.meaning: Committed. Gear reserved, calendar held, serials assigned.

stages.name: Packed
stages.meaning: Packing complete, ready to leave facility.

stages.name: Closed
stages.meaning: Money settled, deposit resolved, nothing open.
